prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern office or classroom setting, viewed from behind the shoulder of a person wearing a light pink turban and glasses, who is attentively watching a presentation. The main focus is a young man standing confidently in front of a large projection screen, mid-speech, gesturing with one hand. He wears a dark blue blazer over a black shirt and light blue jeans, with casual sneakers, embodying a relaxed yet professional style. The projection screen displays a user interface mockup with a clean, minimal design, featuring a prominent red accent on the left and a white content area on the right, suggesting a tech or design-related topic. The background includes a pegboard wall and subtle office details, while the foreground is softly blurred, with sticky notes visible at the bottom edge, adding depth and realism. The color palette is warm and inviting, dominated by soft neutrals, gentle pinks, and muted blues, with natural, diffused lighting that creates a calm, focused atmosphere. The composition uses an over-the-shoulder perspective, evoking a sense of participation and immersion, with a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the presenter and the projected content, reminiscent of a contemporary documentary or tech industry film.
